examples.translation: … no, but I am thrilled by the event [the Eurovision Song Contest]. Especially when [I go] alone, with the listings and stuff.

examples.text: Du bist'n Himmelskörper, wie's geiler nicht geht / Ich bin ja so geflasht—voll fasziniert
examples.translation: You're celestial, it doesn't get better / I'm totally in awe—full‑on amazed
examples.english: You're celestial, it doesn't get better / I'm totally in awe—full‑on amazed

examples.text: Dass das Kollektiv von Sun Ra inspiriert ist, wirkt offensichtlich. „Ich hörte Sun Ra beim Chicago Jazz Festival, als ich 16 war, und es flashte mich total“, erklärt Mazurek.
examples.translation: It appears obvious that the collective is inspired by Sun Ra. “I heard Sun Ra at the Chicago Jazz Festival when I was 16, and it blew me away”, Mazurek explains.
examples.english: It appears obvious that the collective is inspired by Sun Ra. “I heard Sun Ra at the Chicago Jazz Festival when I was 16, and it blew me away”, Mazurek explains.
